summary: Implemented endpoint resolver builtin defaults. Added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults in botocore/args.py (AWS::Region, AWS::UseFIPS, AWS::UseDualStack, SDK::Endpoint, plus AWS::S3::Accelerate and AWS::S3::ForcePathStyle for s3/s3-control), wired into compute_client_args under 'endpoint_resolver_builtins'. Added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 13 tests in tests/unit/test_args.py. test_args.py: 48 passed. Related suites (test_client, test_session, test_utils, test_endpoint): 648 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed. The failure, test_session.py::TestSessionComponent::test_internal_component, also fails on the original code, so it predates this change. Nothing committed.
